declarations.description:
Controller that routes Tab and Shift+Tab when a non-modal popover is opened.
The controller's host element is the popover itself.

The popover is reachable via Tab only from its target, and its content comes
logically right after the target — regardless of the popover's DOM position.
When the popover lives inside a focus trap (e.g. a dialog), the controller
cooperates with the active `FocusTrapController` so the trap never lands
focus on the popover itself.

Modal popovers rely on the overlay's own focus trap; this controller bails
out early in that case.
declarations.name: PopoverFocusController

declarations.name: PopoverOverlayMixin

members.name: bringToFront
members.description: Brings the overlay as visually the frontmost one.

members.name: focusTrap
members.description:
When true, opening the overlay moves focus to the first focusable child,
or to the overlay part with tabindex if there are no focusable children.

members.name: hidden
members.description:
When set to true, the overlay is hidden. This also closes the overlay
immediately in case there is a closing animation in progress.

members.name: horizontalAlign
members.description:
When `positionTarget` is set, this property defines whether to align the overlay's
left or right side to the target element by default.
Possible values are `start` and `end`.
RTL is taken into account when interpreting the value.
The overlay is automatically flipped to the opposite side when it doesn't fit into
the default side defined by this property.

members.name: model
members.description: Object with properties that is passed to `renderer` function

members.name: modeless
members.description:
When true the overlay won't disable the main content, showing
it doesn't change the functionality of the user interface.

members.name: noHorizontalOverlap
members.description:
When `positionTarget` is set, this property defines whether the overlay should overlap
the target element in the x-axis, or be positioned right next to it.

members.name: noVerticalOverlap
members.description:
When `positionTarget` is set, this property defines whether the overlay should overlap
the target element in the y-axis, or be positioned right above/below it.

members.name: opened
members.description: When true, the overlay is visible and attached to body.

members.name: owner
members.description: Owner element passed with renderer function

members.name: positionTarget
members.description:
The element next to which this overlay should be aligned.
The position of the overlay relative to the positionTarget can be adjusted
with properties `horizontalAlign`, `verticalAlign`, `noHorizontalOverlap`
and `noVerticalOverlap`.

members.name: renderer
members.description:
Custom function for rendering the content of the overlay.
Receives three arguments:

- `root` The root container DOM element. Append your content to it.
- `owner` The host element of the renderer function.
- `model` The object with the properties related with rendering.

members.name: requestContentUpdate
members.description:
Requests an update for the content of the overlay.
While performing the update, it invokes the renderer passed in the `renderer` property.

It is not guaranteed that the update happens immediately (synchronously) after it is requested.

members.name: requiredVerticalSpace
members.description:
If the overlay content has no intrinsic height, this property can be used to set
the minimum vertical space (in pixels) required by the overlay. Setting a value to
the property effectively disables the content measurement in favor of using this
fixed value for determining the open direction.

members.name: restoreFocusNode
members.description:
Set to specify the element which should be focused on overlay close,
if `restoreFocusOnClose` is set to true.

members.name: restoreFocusOnClose
members.description: Set to true to enable restoring of focus when overlay is closed.

members.name: setBounds
members.description: Updates the coordinates of the overlay.

members.name: verticalAlign
members.description:
When `positionTarget` is set, this property defines whether to align the overlay's
top or bottom side to the target element by default.
Possible values are `top` and `bottom`.
The overlay is automatically flipped to the opposite side when it doesn't fit into
the default side defined by this property.

members.name: withBackdrop
members.description: When true the overlay has backdrop on top of content when opened.

declarations.description:
`<vaadin-popover>` is a Web Component for creating overlays
that are positioned next to specified DOM element (target).

Unlike `<vaadin-tooltip>`, the popover supports rich content
that can be provided by using `renderer` function.

### Styling

The following shadow DOM parts are available for styling:

Part name        | Description
-----------------|-------------------------------------------
`backdrop`       | Backdrop of the overlay
`overlay`        | The overlay container
`content`        | The overlay content
`arrow`          | Optional arrow pointing to the target when using `theme="arrow"`

The following state attributes are available for styling:

Attribute        | Description
-----------------|----------------------------------------
`position`       | Reflects the `position` property value.

The following custom CSS properties are available for styling:

Custom CSS property                      |
:----------------------------------------|
|`--vaadin-overlay-backdrop-background`  |
|`--vaadin-popover-arrow-border-radius`  |
|`--vaadin-popover-arrow-inset`          |
|`--vaadin-popover-arrow-size`           |
|`--vaadin-popover-background`           |
|`--vaadin-popover-border-color`         |
|`--vaadin-popover-border-radius`        |
|`--vaadin-popover-border-width`         |
|`--vaadin-popover-offset-bottom`        |
|`--vaadin-popover-offset-end`           |
|`--vaadin-popover-offset-start`         |
|`--vaadin-popover-offset-top`           |
|`--vaadin-popover-padding`              |
|`--vaadin-popover-text-color`           |
|`--vaadin-popover-shadow`               |

See [Styling Components](https://vaadin.com/docs/latest/styling/styling-components) documentation.

members.name: accessibleName
members.description: String used to label the popover to screen reader users.
members.deprecated: Use `aria-label` attribute on the popover instead

members.name: accessibleNameRef
members.description: Id of the element used as label of the popover to screen reader users.
members.deprecated: Use `aria-labelledby` attribute on the popover instead

members.name: autofocus
members.description:
When true, the popover content automatically receives focus after
it is opened. Modal popovers use this behavior by default.

members.name: focusDelay
members.description:
The delay in milliseconds before the popover is opened
on focus when the corresponding trigger is used.

When not specified, the global default (500ms) is used.

members.name: for
members.description:
The id of the element to be used as `target` value.
The element should be in the DOM by the time when
the attribute is set, otherwise a warning is shown.

members.name: height
members.description:
Set the height of the popover.
If a unitless number is provided, pixels are assumed.

members.name: hideDelay
members.description:
The delay in milliseconds before the popover is closed
on losing hover, when the corresponding trigger is used.
On blur, the popover is closed immediately.

When not specified, the global default (500ms) is used.

members.name: hoverDelay
members.description:
The delay in milliseconds before the popover is opened
on hover when the corresponding trigger is used.

When not specified, the global default (500ms) is used.

members.name: modal
members.description:
When true, the popover prevents interacting with background elements
by setting `pointer-events` style on the document body to `none`.
This also enables trapping focus inside the popover.

members.name: noCloseOnEsc
members.description: Set to true to disable closing popover on Escape press.

members.name: noCloseOnOutsideClick
members.description: Set to true to disable closing popover on outside click.

members.name: noTabFocus
members.description:
When true, pressing Tab on the target or a sibling element does not move
focus into the popover's content (including any nested popovers), and
Shift+Tab does not move focus into the popover's last focusable. Focus
still moves out of the popover on Tab / Shift+Tab if it was placed
inside programmatically.

Has no effect on modal popovers, which use their own focus trap.

members.name: opened
members.description: True if the popover is visible and available for interaction.

members.name: overlayRole
members.description: The `role` attribute value to be set on the popover.
members.deprecated: Use standard `role` attribute on the popover instead

members.name: position
members.description:
Position of the overlay with respect to the target.
Supported values: `top-start`, `top`, `top-end`,
`bottom-start`, `bottom`, `bottom-end`, `start-top`,
`start`, `start-bottom`, `end-top`, `end`, `end-bottom`.

members.name: renderer
members.description:
Custom function for rendering the content of the popover.
Receives two arguments:

- `root` The root container DOM element. Append your content to it.
- `popover` The reference to the `vaadin-popover` element.
members.deprecated: Use the content in the `vaadin-popover` via default slot

members.name: requestContentUpdate
members.description:
Requests an update for the content of the popover.
While performing the update, it invokes the renderer passed in the `renderer` property.

It is not guaranteed that the update happens immediately (synchronously) after it is requested.
members.deprecated: Add content elements as children of the popover using default slot

members.name: role
members.description:
The `role` attribute value to be set on the popover.
When not specified, defaults to 'dialog'.

members.name: setDefaultFocusDelay
members.description:
Sets the default focus delay to be used by all popover instances,
except for those that have focus delay configured using property.

members.name: setDefaultHideDelay
members.description:
Sets the default hide delay to be used by all popover instances,
except for those that have hide delay configured using property.

members.name: setDefaultHoverDelay
members.description:
Sets the default hover delay to be used by all popover instances,
except for those that have hover delay configured using property.

members.name: target
members.description:
Reference to the DOM element used both to trigger the overlay
by user interaction and to visually position it on the screen.

Defaults to an element referenced with `for` attribute, in
which case it must be located in the same shadow scope.

members.name: trigger
members.description:
Popover trigger mode, used to configure how the popover is opened or closed.
Could be set to multiple by providing an array, e.g. `trigger = ['hover', 'focus']`.

Supported values:
- `click` (default) - opens and closes on target click.
- `hover` - opens on target mouseenter, closes on target mouseleave. Moving mouse
to the popover content keeps the popover opened.
- `focus` - opens on target focus, closes on target blur. Moving focus to the
popover content keeps the popover opened.

In addition to the behavior specified by `trigger`, the popover can be closed by:
- pressing Escape key (unless `noCloseOnEsc` property is true)
- outside click (unless `noCloseOnOutsideClick` property is true)

When setting `trigger` property to `null`, `undefined` or empty array, the popover
can be only opened programmatically by changing `opened` property. Note, closing
on Escape press or outside click is still allowed unless explicitly disabled.

members.name: width
members.description:
Set the width of the popover.
If a unitless number is provided, pixels are assumed.

members.name: withBackdrop
members.description:
When true, the popover has a backdrop (modality curtain) on top of the
underlying page content, covering the whole viewport.
